components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled pill CTA, the page's one dominant action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 14px; background: #cc2a26; color: #ffffff; border: none; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #99201d; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc2a26; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 14px; background: rgba(11,11,12,0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); color: #f5f2ee; border: 1px solid #26262b; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #a8a29b; background: #1b1b1f; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc2a26; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A specialty-coffee counter at closing time: matte black room, one neon-red sign doing all the talking, and a warm halogen halo around the espresso machine where the real color lives. Everything else in the room stays out of that light — text is porcelain and ash, surfaces are graphite, and the only saturated color left is the sign itself.

The page is built to be mistaken for a real business's site, so the aesthetic philosophy is confidence over decoration: one dominant accent used sparingly, a cartel-style display face for anything that needs to shout, warm unretouched photography for anything that needs to prove the coffee is real, and a grain overlay that reads as light through steam rather than as a filter. Nothing about the system announces "template" — every rule below exists because a specific measured problem (a contrast ratio, a line-height collision, a sticky-scroll edge case) forced it, not because it looked nice in isolation.

Confirmed rejection: no inverted/light sections anywhere in the scroll. The black is total; a white section would break the room.
keyCharacteristics: Matte black stage, single red sign, warm photography as the only other color
Cartel/menu-board display type (Anton) against a quiet grotesque body face
Flat by default — depth comes from tonal layering and hairlines, not shadows
Two shapes only: pill for anything you can press, 20px card radius for anything you look at
Porteño specificity in every string of copy, never generic café language

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: Sign Red is the only saturated color the interface ever puts a decision behind. If a second saturated hue starts carrying UI meaning, it competes with the sign and both lose.

rules.name: The Faint-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Spent Grounds falls short of AA for text. Anything carrying information belongs in Ash Taupe, never Spent Grounds.

rules.name: The Hero-Only Rule
rules.body: Espresso Shell, Roast Amber, and Crema Gold are photo-derived atmosphere confined to the hero shader and halo. No control, body text, or border ever uses them.

rules.name: The Two-Tempo Headline Rule
rules.body: Any headline pairing a setup line with a punchline sets the punchline at more than double the setup's size, in Sign Red.

rules.name: The 0.96 Rule
rules.body: Anton's cap-height overshoots a 0.9 line-box enough to clip an accented capital into the line above. 0.96 line-height is the measured floor for legible multi-line display headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card at rest never casts a shadow; depth reads from which of the three tonal planes it sits on.

rules.name: The Two-Shape Rule
rules.body: Pill for anything interactive, 20px card radius for anything you look at. No third radius.

dos: Do keep Sign Red to the same rarity as a real neon sign — buttons, one headline punchline per section, selected states.
Do use Neon Red instead of the base accent for any red text or icon sitting on a photo or on black.
Do build depth with the void → concrete → raised tonal stack and a hairline border, not a shadow.
Do keep every headline in Anton, uppercase, at 0.96 line-height on anything that wraps to more than one line.
Do write copy with named streets and concrete porteño detail.
donts: Don't let Espresso Shell / Roast Amber / Crema Gold leave the hero shader and halo.
Don't put informational text in Spent Grounds — it measures below AA for text; use Ash Taupe.
Don't invert a section to a light background. The black is total.
Don't give a resting card a shadow, or under-weight the demo sheet's shadow — it needs to read as physically above the page.
Don't introduce a third corner radius. Interactive is pill, content is 20px, nothing else.
